description: Get raw data for a single LinkedIn section by exact name. Use when you need one specific section or the raw API response. Section names are case-sensitive.

domain.description: Section name (case-sensitive). Résumé: PROFILE, PROFILE_SUMMARY, POSITIONS, EDUCATION, SKILLS, CERTIFICATIONS, PROJECTS, ORGANIZATIONS, LANGUAGES, HONORS, COURSES, PUBLICATIONS, PATENTS, VOLUNTEERING_EXPERIENCES, RECOMMENDATIONS. Activity: CONNECTIONS, MEMBER_SHARE_INFO, ARTICLES, ALL_COMMENTS, ALL_LIKES, JOB_APPLICATIONS, JOB_POSTINGS, SAVED_JOBS, JOB_SEEKER_PREFERENCES.

maxPages.description: Max pages of results to fetch (1–25). Each page holds ~10 records. Lower this to keep responses small.

name: linkedin_get_section

apiVersion.description: LinkedIn API version used for the request.

rawElements.description: Raw LinkedIn API elements (with metadata) for advanced use.

snapshotData.description: List of records for this section.

truncated.description: True if more results exist beyond the page limit.

title: Get one LinkedIn section
